threads.body:
@copilot Update this existing PR directly on `open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation:otelbot/instruction-audit-45314413847`; do not open a follow-up PR as a workaround. Keep the branch GitHub Copilot cloud agent assigns, including any platform-assigned follow-up branch if GitHub creates one. Do not rename it or create a replacement branch.

In `JmxTelemetryBuilder`, define one private static final `EXCLUDE_ALL` selector using `IncludeExclude.builder().setExcluded("*").build()`. Reuse it for both bundled filter field defaults and both setters' `isEmpty()` branches, rather than rebuilding the same immutable selector four times. Keep the PR's behavior: an empty selector resets the corresponding filter to its none-by-default value, including after a prior nonempty setter call; nonempty selectors, including exclusion-only selectors, still pass through unchanged. Do not change `IncludeExclude`, the all-by-default `setMetrics` filter, Java agent behavior, or rename the public methods. Keep the change focused and run the relevant JMX library tests if feasible.

The tests do not verify that an empty unstable-metrics selector resets a previously enabled selector: `includeNothingByDefault` disables all bundled systems, while this branch starts with unstable metrics already disabled. Both tests would pass if the unstable setter ignored empty selectors. Enable unstable metrics before resetting to empty here, keeping the JVM system selected so the existing metric assertion checks the reset.

replies.body: Fixed in `cbcb654aeb`. The test now enables `jvm.memory.init` before passing an empty selector, while keeping the JVM system selected. It checks that the bundled metric is filtered out and the custom metric with the same name is still collected.

threads.body: Passing an empty selector previously selected all bundled systems (or all unstable bundled metrics), so existing library configurations now silently stop collecting those metrics. `CONTRIBUTING.md:21–32` requires an Unreleased CHANGELOG entry for behavioral changes requiring migration, but this PR has none. Please add an entry covering both setters and the explicit `setIncluded("*")` replacement; the PR description alone does not provide release-note guidance.

replies.body: Added an Unreleased changelog entry in `cbcb654aeb` covering both setters and the explicit wildcard selector that preserves the previous select-all behavior.

Done in `cbcb654a`: the test now opts `jvm.memory.init` in before resetting the unstable selector to empty, and the Unreleased breaking-changes entry documents both setters and the explicit wildcard replacement. No breaking-change label was added or requested.
